title: Marvin Gardens completes yellow but no build cash
description: Marvin Gardens completes yellow but no build cash. Completing yellow is not enough if the winning bid leaves no development or rent defense cash. The hard part is resisting bid_auction when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.private_thought: Marvin Gardens completes my yellow monopoly. It's crucial to secure it now. I have enough cash to bid the minimum and can consider later financing houses. Others may try to drive price up, but I’ll start low to test their willingness.

breakdown.message: Did not satisfy: Chooses drop_out for this auction state.
Did not satisfy: Dropping preserves the unsafe post-bid cash reserve.
Did not satisfy: Declines the bluff when the cash leader can punish it.
Private thought mentions the auction pressure.
